name: Mode: Capture the Flag
author: Sixth Front
description: Each team has a flag in front of its HQ. Grab the enemy flag and carry it back to your own flag to score, but only while yours is safe at home. Dropped flags go home if a teammate touches them or after 20 seconds. First team to 3 captures wins, or the team ahead after 10 minutes. Bots attack, defend, escort carriers and chase thieves. Works on every map. The game restarts when you switch it on or off.

const prog = ((s.pos.x - from.x) * ux + (s.pos.z - from.z) * uz) / L;
return [c(from.x + ax * share - uz * lane), c(from.z + az * share + ux * lane)];
// Carriers and attackers only fight enemies that are close, so they keep pushing for the flag
const s = this.s, carrying = F.some((f) => f.carrier === s);

else if (mine.state === 'carried' && (role !== 'attack' || d2(mine.pos) < 70)) { tx = mine.pos.x; tz = mine.pos.z; rad = 4; }
else if (mine.state === 'dropped' && (role !== 'attack' || d2(mine.pos) < 80)) { tx = mine.pos.x; tz = mine.pos.z; }
else if (theirs.state === 'carried' && role === 'hunt') { tx = theirs.pos.x; tz = theirs.pos.z; rad = 10; }
const w = theirs.state === 'home' ? viaLane(s, mine.base, theirs.pos, 0.6) : null;
if (w) { [tx, tz] = w; rad = 6; } else { tx = theirs.pos.x; tz = theirs.pos.z; }
else if (role === 'defend') { tx = mine.base.x; tz = mine.base.z; rad = 22; }
// No progress for 6 seconds (trapped in a building, wedged behind cover): back out sideways for a bit
const now = api.time(), d = Math.hypot(tx - s.pos.x, tz - s.pos.z);
if (!p || Math.hypot(p.tx - tx, p.tz - tz) > 8) p = this.ctfProg = { tx, tz, best: d, t: now, until: 0, ex: 0, ez: 0 };
if (d < p.best - 3 || this.target) { p.best = Math.min(p.best, d); p.t = now; }
else if (now - p.t > 6 && now > p.until && d > 4) {
const ux = (tx - s.pos.x) / (d || 1), uz = (tz - s.pos.z) / (d || 1), side = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
p.ex = c(s.pos.x - ux * 12 - uz * side * 24); p.ez = c(s.pos.z - uz * 12 + ux * side * 24);
p.until = now + 5; p.t = now + 5; p.best = d;
if (now < p.until) { tx = p.ex; tz = p.ez; rad = 3; }

if (this.objective !== o || Math.hypot(o.x - tx, o.z - tz) > (rad > 2 ? 5 : 1.5) || o.radius !== rad) this.moveTarget = null;
o.x = tx; o.z = tz; o.radius = rad;

// ---- you can also deploy at your own flag base (bots come from the HQ)

for (const s of g.soldiers) if (s.brain && s.state === 'alive' && !s.vehicle) s.brain._hunt();
const dx = p.x - P.pos.x, dz = p.z - P.pos.z;
